summary: Ignore file entries are one per line with a relative file path and a test name (with optional -pythonversion and :errorcode) separated by a single space, plus optional trailing # comments; !skip skips a test for a file.
questions: What is the format of a sanity ignore entry?
How do I ignore a specific validate-modules error code?
Can I add comments in the ignore file?

answer_card.title: Ignore file format
answer_card.answer_md:
One entry per line: `<path> <test>[-<python>][:<code>]`, separated by a single space. Paths are relative to the content root and can't contain spaces or `#`. Trailing `# comment` is allowed; blank or comment-only lines are not.
```text
roles/my_role/files/my_script.sh shellcheck:SC2154 # undefined variable
plugins/modules/my_module.py validate-modules:missing-gplv3-license
plugins/modules/my_module.py import-3.8
```
Use `<test>!skip` (no error code) to skip a test for a file.
